attribute.name.blightcaller.curse_durati: Your curses last longer. Each curse deals its damage for more seconds before it runs out.
death.attack.blightcaller.curse.player: %1$s withered away under the curse of %2$s
commands.blightcaller.curse.not_a_curse: %s is not a curse (mob effect tag #blightcaller:curses)
commands.blightcaller.curse.apply.done: Cursed %s with %s for %s s: %s damage per tick (power %s x factor %s)%s
item.blightcaller.spell_book/blightcalle:
Spell Book of Blightcallers, cursing foes with soul magic that rots them over time
- Strengths: Damage over time, weakening, strong against tough enemies and bosses
- Weaknesses: Slow start, little burst damage, very low defense
- Equipment: Lightly armored
effect.blightcaller.soul_rot.description: Takes soul damage every second for a long time.
effect.blightcaller.enfeeble.description: Takes more damage from all sources. A curse without damage of its own.
spell.blightcaller.hex_bolt.name: Hex Bolt
spell.blightcaller.hex_bolt.description: Hurls a bolt of hex, causing {damage} soul spell damage and setting Soulburn on the target.
spell.blightcaller.blight_burst.name: Blight Burst
spell.blightcaller.blight_burst.descript: Launches a ball of blight that bursts on impact, causing {damage} soul spell damage and setting Soulburn on all enemies within {impact_range} blocks.
spell.blightcaller.soul_rot.name: Soul Rot
spell.blightcaller.soul_rot.description: Curses the target with Soul Rot, rotting its soul for a long time.
spell.blightcaller.enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
spell.blightcaller.enfeeble.description: Curses the target with Enfeeble, making it more vulnerable to all damage. Deals no damage itself.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_damage: %1$s: %2$s soul damage per second for %3$s s (%4$s in total).
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_weaken: %1$s for %2$s s: the target takes %3$s more damage from all sources (bosses %4$s).
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_level_b: +%1$s damage per curse on the target, up to %2$s curses.
effect.blightcaller.soul_rend.descriptio: The soul is torn open by Drain Soul. A curse without damage of its own.
effect.blightcaller.pestilence.descripti: Takes soul damage every second and spreads the plague to enemies nearby.
spell.blightcaller.gravebind.name: Gravebind
spell.blightcaller.drain_soul.name: Drain Soul
spell.blightcaller.pestilence.name: Pestilence
spell.blightcaller.pestilence.descriptio: Curses the target with Pestilence, a plague that rots its soul and spreads to enemies nearby.
spell.blightcaller.last_rites.name: Last Rites
spell.blightcaller.last_rites.descriptio: Speaks the last rites over all enemies around you, detonating your curses on them.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_slow: %1$s for %2$s s: the target moves %3$s slower (bosses %4$s).
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_mark: %1$s: lasts %2$s s after the last hit, no damage of its own, counts as a curse.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_spread: Every %1$s s each carrier infects an enemy within %2$s blocks that has no Pestilence, up to %3$s carriers per cast (the target included). Copies keep the remaining time.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.last_rites: Detonates your own curses with damage: the damage of their next %1$s s × %2$s at once, then they are gone. Curses of other players and curses without damage stay.
effect.blightcaller.gravebind.descriptio: Ghostly chains hold the target: it moves much slower, also in the air. A curse without damage of its own.
spell.blightcaller.gravebind.description: Ghostly chains burst from the ground around you, causing {damage} soul spell damage to all enemies nearby and binding them with Gravebind.
spell.blightcaller.drain_soul.descriptio: Channels a stream that tears the soul out of the target, dealing {damage} soul spell damage and healing you by {heal} every second. Tears the soul open with Soul Rend.

blightcaller.configuration.title: Blightcaller Configuration
blightcaller.configuration.curse_ticks.t: Feedback of the damage curses deal every second. Real hits always flash and sound.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_tick_fl: A cursed mob flashes red on every curse tick. Only for you.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_tick_so: A cursed mob plays its hurt sound on every curse tick. Only for you.
